analyst: Manual analysis using Claude Opus 5.5 for verification and code analysis

servers.server_cost: Free for job seekers (no prices given); Indeed account required
servers.linked_cost: Indeed is free for job seekers
servers.restrictions: Claude Connector only (Claude.ai, Claude Desktop); Indeed account required; countries not specified; beta
servers.governance_logic: Scopes mirror the tool set exactly (read only, separate scope for the profile/resume); a separate endpoint for one AI client (/claude/mcp). Everything else not documented.
servers.structure_note: Flat; endpoint path specific to Claude
servers.agent_cannot: Apply for jobs (only links); edit the resume; correspond with employers; save jobs, subscribe to alerts; employer functions.
servers.gov_promises: Indeed Terms of Service and Privacy Policy "plus any third-party terms that apply to the AI or LLM model used"; not stated that the resume is passed to the AI provider.
servers.notes: Endpoint https://mcp.indeed.com/claude/mcp (separate path for Claude). Beta.

Tools.desc: 4: Job Search (title, keywords, location, employment type -> titles, companies, locations, salaries, application links); Job Detail (by job ID); Get Resume (experience from the user's profile); Get Company Data (satisfaction, compensation, culture, management, reviews)

Authorization.desc: Sign-in to the Indeed account; protected resource metadata published; scopes job_seeker.jobs.search, job_seeker.company.details.read, job_seeker.profile.read, offline_access

actions.desc: Search for jobs; returns titles, companies, locations, salaries and application links
actions.params: title/keywords; location; employment type (exact schema not published)

actions.desc: Get the details of a job
Get the user's own resume (experience) from the Indeed profile (scope job_seeker.profile.read)
Get company data: satisfaction, compensation, culture, management, reviews

observations.text: A server "for one client" (Claude only, its own URL path): the vendor chooses which AIs to work with.
The user's personal data (resume) has a separate scope job_seeker.profile.read - a good example of granular rights.
Strictly read-only and a minimal set - the agent has no actions with consequences.
